# Dragon Door

> > Dragon Door was a leading publisher and retailer of strength training equipment and instructional materials, specializing in kettlebell training, bodyweight exercises, and isometrics before closing operations.

Founded by John Du Cane, Dragon Door pioneered the modern kettlebell movement in the West and published influential training books including The Purposeful Primitive, Convict Conditioning, Beyond Bodybuilding, and The Ultimate Isometrics Manual. The company also offered RKC (Russian Kettlebell Challenge) and HKC instructor certifications.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell training and RKC certification
- Bodyweight training and Convict Conditioning
- Isometrics and strength training
- The Purposeful Primitive
- Beyond Bodybuilding
- The Ultimate Isometrics Manual
- The Hardstyle Kettlebell Challenge
- HKC (Hardstyle Kettlebell Challenge) certification
- John Du Cane (founder)
- Strength training equipment and books
- Instructor workshops and certifications
- Business closure (now closed)
